issues.description: The problem specification and UML require addGuestStudents(int, String) (an int plus a reason String), but the solution implementation provides addGuestStudents(int) with only a single int parameter. The template leaves a TODO without a concrete signature, which lets this mismatch slip in. This parameter mismatch can confuse students about the required method signature and cause tests that expect the two-parameter form to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the specification: change the method signature to addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) in the solution (and optionally add the same signature stub in the template). The method can accept the reason parameter even if it only logs or ignores it, but it must be present so students and tests align with the problem statement and UML.
